personality: Steady, watchful and slow to shoot. He has been tracking this one for a long time.
voice: Do I find you here, you old sinner?

cards.title: Years on the Trail
cards.text: He knew every path in the wood, and for years he had tracked one old wolf that always slipped away. One day, passing the old woman's cottage, he heard snoring far louder than any grandmother could make. Worried that she was ill, he went in. There in her bed lay the wolf. He had long sought him, and now he had found him.

source.author: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm, 1812–57; English by Margaret Hunt, 1884

cards.title: Scissors, Not a Shot
cards.text: He raised his gun, then lowered it. The wolf might have swallowed the grandmother, and she might still be saved. So he took a pair of scissors and carefully cut open the sleeping wolf's belly. After a few snips he saw a red cap shining, and a little girl sprang out, and then the grandmother after her, weak but alive.

source.author: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm, 1812–57; English by Margaret Hunt, 1884

cards.title: Home With the Pelt
cards.text: The girl fetched great stones, and they filled the wolf's belly with them. When he woke and tried to escape, he fell down dead. The huntsman skinned the old enemy he had chased for so long and went home with the pelt, while the grandmother ate the cake and drank the wine, and all three of them were glad.

source.author: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm, 1812–57; English by Margaret Hunt, 1884
